def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    base = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep = next(v for v, _ in counts.most_common() if v != base)

    # Grid intersections lie on rows without the interior fill color.
    boundary_rows = [r for r in range(h) if base not in grid[r]]
    boundary_set = set(boundary_rows)

    # Vertical grid lines are uniformly the separator color away from boundaries.
    body_rows = [r for r in range(h) if r not in boundary_set]
    boundary_cols = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if body_rows and all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in body_rows)
    ]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(boundary_rows) - 1):
        row = []
        r1, r2 = boundary_rows[i], boundary_rows[i + 1]
        for j in range(len(boundary_cols) - 1):
            c1, c2 = boundary_cols[j], boundary_cols[j + 1]
            corners = (
                grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2],
                grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]
            )
            if corners[0] != sep and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(base)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    colors = counts.most_common()
    background = colors[0][0]
    separator = colors[1][0]

    # The separator forms the regularly spaced horizontal and vertical grid lines.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r].count(separator) > w / 2]
    cols = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if sum(grid[r][c] == separator for r in range(h)) > h / 2
    ]

    result = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            ]
            freq = Counter(corners)
            color, n = freq.most_common(1)[0]
            out_row.append(color if n >= 3 else background)
        result.append(out_row)
    return result

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill, line = [color for color, _ in counts.most_common(2)]

    # Grid boundaries are the rows and columns where the tile fill is absent.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if fill not in grid[r]]
    middle_rows = [r for r in range(h) if r not in rows]
    cols = [
        c for c in range(w)
        if middle_rows and all(grid[r][c] != fill for r in middle_rows)
    ]

    result = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = [
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]],
                grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]],
            ]
            color = corners[0]
            out_row.append(
                color if color not in (fill, line) and all(x == color for x in corners)
                else fill
            )
        result.append(out_row)
    return result
